content.title: About
content.content: Whipped topping is a ready‑to‑use aerated dessert product made from cream, sugar and stabilizers. It has a light, airy texture, a gentle buttery flavor and is used to garnish and enrich desserts, drinks and baked goods.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whipped topping is often sold in aerosol cans, which makes dispensing convenient.
The formulation may contain vegetable oils, providing greater stability during storage.
In some countries the product is fortified with vitamins A and D.
Its texture is achieved by injecting air under pressure, increasing the volume 5–7 times.
Whipped topping can be sweetened or neutral, allowing use in a variety of culinary applications.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Cream, like other dairy products, provides calcium essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Vitamin D
items.content: Some versions are fortified with vitamin D, which supports the immune system and calcium absorption.

items.title: Low carbohydrate content
items.content: Whipped topping typically contains modest amounts of sugar, making it suitable for moderate consumption in low‑carb diets.

items.title: Enhances flavor
items.content: Adding whipped topping can boost taste perception without the need for large amounts of heavy cream.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: The product contains dairy proteins and may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Whipped topping is rich in fats, so it should be consumed in moderation, especially when managing weight.

items.title: Stabilizer content
items.content: Certain stabilizers (e.g., emulsifiers) may cause discomfort in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Pressurized storage
items.content: Aerosol cans require careful handling; a damaged can can pose a safety hazard.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Whipped topping can be added to desserts, cakes, ice cream, coffee, hot chocolate, and used to decorate fruit and pastries. It can be lightly whipped with a spoon for a firmer texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the can in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use the product within 2–3 days. Do not store at temperatures above 25°C.
